description: Scaling applied to a polyphonic signal as a whole and channel by channel, in 4HP

params.text: Chooses what the eight knobs below act on: PRI gives each of them one channel, SEC gives each of them a group of channels
Scales every channel, -1x fully counter-clockwise through 0x in the centre to +1x fully clockwise, and further under the scale range
Attenuates and inverts the All scale CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Steps the scale range of every knob through 1x, 2x, 5x and 10x, with a light showing which is active
Scales one channel in PRI mode, or the group of channels named in blue beneath it in SEC mode

inputs.text: Adds to the All scale after the trim; a polyphonic signal here scales each channel by its own amount

outputs.text: Carries the input with every scaling applied

notes: a red light beside the Poly label at the bottom warns that some channel is being scaled by more than one control at once, which multiplies the two together
there is no incremental section on this module, which is the visible difference from Poly-Offset
menu: Polyphony: Auto, 1 (monophonic) up to 16 channels — fixes the number of output channels instead of following the input
Set SCALE1-8 to 0 — turns all eight channel knobs fully down, for isolating one channel by turning its knob back up
Set SCALE1-8 to 1 — puts all eight channel knobs at unity
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±1V.
